step1_analysis.description: A passive capacitive network extracted from a 2.5-GHz Q-enhanced LC filter, likely representing transistor parasitic capacitances or a varactor sub-circuit.

paper_reference.title: A 2.5-GHz Low-Power, High Dynamic Range, Self-Tuned Q-Enhanced LC Filter in SOI

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the LC tank resonance.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the active filter

sky130_expected.calculation: P = VDD * I_total. For 5mA at 1.8V (SKY130), P = 9 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled for 1.8V supply in SKY130 compared to 3V in the paper.

gain.description: Voltage gain of the filter at center frequency

sky130_expected.calculation: Depends on Q-enhancement transconductance and tank parallel resistance.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Similar gain can be achieved in SKY130 by tuning the cross-coupled pair.

sky130_expected.calculation: Ratio of 1-dB compression power to noise floor.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on noise figure and linearity, which are comparable in SKY130.
Targeted for specific wireless standards (e.g., Bluetooth).

equivalent_capacitance.description: Equivalent capacitance of the extracted sub-circuit at IN

sky130_expected.calculation: C_eq = CFIX || (CDS + (CGD*CGS)/(CGD+CGS)). Assuming 1pF for all, C_eq = 0.6pF.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the actual sizing of the capacitors in the layout.

sky130_expected.calculation: Z = 1 / (2 * pi * f * C_eq). For 0.6pF at 2.5GHz, Z = 106 ohms.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Inversely proportional to the equivalent capacitance.

step3_testbench.description: Measures the equivalent capacitance and input impedance of the passive capacitive network at 2.5 GHz. Note: Full filter metrics (gain, power, etc.) cannot be simulated on this passive sub-circuit alone.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Capacitive Network

.param c_val=1p

* DUT (Values appended to satisfy SPICE syntax)
CDS N0 GND {c_val}
CFIX N0 IN {c_val}
CGS N1 GND {c_val}
CGD N0 N1 {c_val}

* Sources
VGND GND 0 DC 0
VIN IN GND DC 0 AC 1

.control
ac dec 100 100MEG 10G

* Calculate equivalent capacitance and impedance
let omega = 2 * PI * frequency
let i_in = -i(VIN)
let z_in = 1 / i_in
let c_eq = imag(i_in) / omega

* Measure at 2.5 GHz
meas ac C_eq_2_5G find c_eq at=2.5G
meas ac Z_in_2_5G find mag(z_in) at=2.5G

print C_eq_2_5G Z_in_2_5G
.endc

.end
